afterTheFirstStartTheAgent: After the first start the agent keeps its key in the volume and no longer needs the token.
agentWillBeDeletedTogetherWith: Agent “{name}” will be deleted together with everything it reported.
anAgentChecksStreamsFromIts: An agent checks streams from its own network and sends the results to the server itself — no incoming connections to it are needed. One stream can be checked from several vantage points.
behind: {n} stream is checked late | {n} streams are checked late
behindHint: Checks of these streams start later than they should by more than their interval: the agent, or what it checks, is too slow for them.
howFarTheAgentSClock: How far the agent's clock is from the server's clock
latinLettersDigitsDotHyphenAnd: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore. Usually the place the agent will watch from.
overloadedHint: The checks do not get the processor time they need ({cores} of {limit} cores in use). Until that passes, slow downloads and timeouts are not reported as problems of the streams: they may be the agent's own delay.
queueDropped: {n} result lost: the queue was full | {n} results lost: the queue was full
queueFailing: Cannot write to its queue: results are being lost
queueWaiting: {n} result in the queue, the oldest for {age} | {n} results in the queue, the oldest for {age}
queueWaitingHint: Results the agent has made but not delivered to the server yet ({size}). They are kept on the agent's disk and sent when the server is reachable.
serverAddressIsLocal: The server address in the command is {url}: it works on this machine only, and an agent, a containerised one included, will not find the server there. Replace it with the address the server is reached at from the agent host, or set HLSMON_PUBLIC_URL for the server.
theCurrentKeyOfAgentWill: The current key of agent “{name}” will stop working. A running agent will stay disconnected until it is started with the new token.
theTokenIsShownOnceIt: The token is shown once. It is valid until {time} and works for one connection.
